info.title: astrea-sda-api
info.description: A high-performance Rust API for Space Domain Awareness (SDA), satellite tracking, SGP4 propagation, and visibility prediction

post.summary: Developer Account Login & JWT Token Generation
post.description: Authenticates developer account credentials and returns an RS256/Supabase JWT Bearer token for API access and Swagger UI authorization.

200.description: Authenticated successfully and JWT token issued

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid email or password

get.description: Returns decoded JWT claims and profile info for the authenticated caller.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing Bearer token

post.description: Registers a new developer account and issues an authenticated RS256/Supabase JWT Bearer token.

200.description: Developer account registered and JWT token issued

400.description: Invalid registration request or email already exists

post.summary: RFC 7523 Private Key JWT Client Assertion M2M Token Exchange
post.description: Authenticates machine-to-machine service accounts via signed RSA Private Key assertions (`client_assertion_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer`) and returns a scoped RS256 JWT Bearer token.

200.description: M2M Client assertion verified and JWT Bearer token issued

400.description: Invalid client assertion format or unsupported grant type

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid assertion signature or expired timestamp

post.description: Computes 2D encounter-plane collision probability (Pc) using Foster's algorithm given miss distance, relative velocity, hard-body radius, and combined position covariance uncertainty. Protected by JWT auth (requires 'viewer', 'editor', or 'admin' role).

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Evaluates close-approach orbital conjunctions across all active satellites using Rayon parallel execution. Protected by JWT auth (requires 'viewer', 'editor', or 'admin' role).

parameters.name: max_distance_km
parameters.description: Maximum threshold distance in km between satellites to trigger a conjunction match (default: 10.0 km)

parameters.name: duration_hours
parameters.description: Forecast window forward in hours (default: 24 hrs, max: 72)

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Triggers automated CelesTrak discovery pipeline synchronization for a specific satellite group. Protected by JWT auth (requires 'admin' role).

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: CelesTrak satellite group name to synchronize. Options: 'curated' (default: stations, visual, last-30-days), 'all', 'stations', 'visual', 'starlink', 'weather', 'last-30-days', 'active', or a comma-separated list (e.g. 'stations,visual').

parameters.name: max_age_hours
parameters.description: Maximum allowed data age in hours before triggering a CelesTrak query (default: 12.0 hours). If existing data was synced within this period, CelesTrak requests are skipped to prevent spamming.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force an immediate fetch from CelesTrak, bypassing freshness checks.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid or unknown satellite group

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of satellites using base64 checkpoint cursors. Protected by JWT auth (requires 'viewer', 'editor', or 'admin' role).

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Creates a new satellite record from Two-Line Element (TLE) set data. Protected by JWT auth (requires 'editor' or 'admin' role).

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

get.summary: Atmospheric Drag & Orbital Decay Re-Entry Watch
get.description: Scans the satellite catalog for debris and satellites experiencing severe atmospheric drag or nearing uncontrolled atmospheric re-entry. Protected by JWT auth (requires 'viewer', 'editor', or 'admin' role).

parameters.name: max_perigee_km
parameters.description: Maximum perigee altitude threshold in km to flag re-entry hazard (default: 300.0 km)

parameters.name: min_bstar
parameters.description: Minimum B* atmospheric drag coefficient threshold (default: 0.0001)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of decaying objects to return (default: 50, max: 500)

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Computes the satellite closest to overhead (highest elevation) across all tracked satellites using parallel Rayon propagation. Protected by JWT auth (requires 'viewer', 'editor', or 'admin' role).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Observer latitude in decimal degrees (-90.0 to 90.0)

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees (-180.0 to 180.0)

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Observer altitude above sea level in meters

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: UTC timestamp for calculation epoch (defaults to current time if omitted)

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Retrieves details for a specific satellite by its unique UUID. Protected by JWT auth (requires 'viewer', 'editor', or 'admin' role).

parameters.name: id

get.summary: Get Satellite Atmospheric Drag & Decay Risk
get.description: Evaluates perigee/apogee altitude, B* atmospheric drag decay rate, remaining orbital lifetime, and uncontrolled re-entry risk score. Protected by JWT auth (requires 'viewer', 'editor', or 'admin' role).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Satellite unique UUID identifier

200.description: Satellite orbital decay risk assessed successfully

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

AuthResponse.description: Response returned upon successful RS256 JWT token generation.

Claims.description: JWT Claims payload structure containing standard OIDC and OAuth 2.0 claim fields.

exp.description: Expiration timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch

iat.description: Issued-at timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch

iss.description: Token issuer (OIDC issuer URI or auth server ID)

scope.description: Space-separated OAuth 2.0 scopes string (e.g. "read:satellites write:satellites admin:satellites")

sub.description: Subject (User ID, username, or client service ID)

ClientAssertionRequest.description: Request body for RFC 7523 Private Key JWT Client Assertion token exchange (M2M authentication).

clientAssertion.description: RS256-signed JWT assertion token generated using client's RSA private key

CnfClaim.description: RFC 8705 OIDC Confirmation Claim (`cnf`) containing SHA-256 certificate thumbprint (`x5t#S256`).

DetectedManeuver.description:
A candidate maneuver: an element discontinuity between two consecutive TLEs that
exceeds the requested thresholds. It happened somewhere inside the window; TLEs
cannot localise it further. Unmodelled drag or TLE fit errors can also cause one.

inclinationChangeDeg.description: Observed mean inclination change, in degrees

semiMajorAxisResidualKm.description:
Observed mean semi-major axis minus the value predicted by the earlier TLE's
mean-motion derivatives, in km

LoginRequest.description: Request body for developer account login.

ManeuverType.description:
Observed element change between two consecutive TLEs. Describes what changed, not why:
burn intent (stationkeeping, collision avoidance, ...) is not observable from TLEs.

OrbitalParameterResidual.description: Mean elements of one TLE and, for every TLE after the first, its change from the previous.

ageHours.description: Current age of the data in hours at query time

lastSyncedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this group was last synchronized from CelesTrak

status.description: Freshness status: 'synced' (fetched from CelesTrak) or 'fresh' (skipped because records are within maxAgeHours)

syncedCount.description: Number of satellites upserted for this specific group (0 if skipped because data was already fresh)

availableGroups.description: Available CelesTrak groups supported by the API

force.description: Whether force mode was enabled to bypass freshness checks

group.description: Requested group name or descriptive summary

groups.description: Detailed per-group synchronization counts and freshness status

maxAgeHours.description: Maximum age limit applied in hours

syncedCount.description: Total number of satellites newly updated across all groups

SignupRequest.description: Request body for developer account registration.

UserRole.description: Modern OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Role Hierarchy for Satellite API RBAC.
